note: Setup already installs EaglerXPaper (modern EaglerXServer for Paper 26.2). Do not add EaglerXServer.jar — it would conflict.

addons.title: EaglerMOTD
addons.description: Custom MOTD and server list text for Eagler browser clients (uses the EaglerX API).

addons.title: EaglerWeb
addons.description: Serve small files over HTTP from your server address (skins, packs, etc.).

addons.title: EaglerXRewind
addons.description: Let very old Eagler 1.5.2 clients join (protocol rewrite). Not needed if you only use Eagler 26.2.

addons.title: EaglerXPlan
addons.description: Adds Eagler player data to the Plan analytics plugin (install Plan from Modrinth first).

addons.title: EaglerXBackendRPC
addons.description: Talk to a Bungee/Velocity Eagler proxy from a backend Spigot server. Only for split proxy networks.
